Engine validation evidence is reproducible: evidence_digest 9af271e46b8f47602422e0159781e2e14f6b9dd8a854d5b7101b2fcd14c3317b was produced identically by two runs at different generated_utc values, so the findings are a function of code and data only.
273 tests pass: the 27 Stage 0 and 113 Stage 1 tests unmodified, plus 133 added by Stage 2 (54 unit, 42 adversarial, 37 integration).

A defect in the evidence writer was found by post-build verification and not by the suite: the field describing what evidence_digest covers was appended after the digest was taken, so the file asserted a coverage it did not have and a reader recomputing the digest as documented got a different value. No finding was affected. The writer now seals the description before hashing and three unit tests enforce it; this package supersedes the one built before the repair. See section 14.1 of the report.
limitations: The spread is a declared constant, not a measurement. No historical quote data exists in the Stage 1 dataset, so 2.5 bps per side is charged on every symbol in every year: wider than a modern quoted spread for a large ETF, narrower than a 1990s one.
Slippage is a modelled constant, not drawn from any observed fill distribution.
Partial fills are not modelled. An order fills in full or not at all. A partial-fill distribution would have to be invented; it is a gate 7 paper-trading observable.
Market-on-next-open is the only order type modelled. No limit orders, no stops, no intraday timing. A strategy requiring them is outside what this engine has been validated for.
The SEC section 31 rate and the FINRA TAF per-share rate are single fixed values across 28 years of statutory rate changes.

The TAF is charged on adjusted share counts, because as-traded share counts are not recoverable from this provider. Adjusted counts are greater than or equal to as-traded counts, so this over-charges, by a margin that grows with the number of splits behind the fill.
The cash benchmark pays 0% because no T-bill series was acquired at Stage 1. This is conservative for judging cash and generous for judging a strategy that must beat it.

Every Stage 1 data limitation is inherited whole — single provider, unquantified residual ETF closure bias, split-adjusted-only price space, no as-traded prices, and the one disclosed adjustment-consistency failure. An engine cannot be more trustworthy than its inputs.
Delisting is enforced but has never been tested against a real delisting: the frozen universe contains no delisted symbol, so the guard is exercised on synthetic series only.

Validation is against the sealed acceptance spec, not against a second independent implementation. No cross-implementation comparison was performed; the independent check is hand arithmetic over one synthetic instrument and eight sessions.
The dividend model credits cash and never reinvests. Correct for an engine, and a real constraint on any strategy later built on it.

deterministic_reruns.required: deterministic reruns produce identical trades and equity curves

evidence.digest_definition: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of the trade list and of the equity curve, carrying no run id, no timestamp, no label and no path
evidence.falsifiability: tests assert the digest carries no run identity, that base and stressed costs produce different digests, and that symbol insertion order does not change the result; without the second, equality would be unfalsifiable

defect_classes_detected.required: tests detect look-ahead, same-close fill, split/dividend, delisting, stale-price, cash, rounding, fee, slippage, rejected-order, and duplicate-order errors

classes.mutation: a probe asks the market view for a bar at or after the session following the decision session
classes.detector: LookAheadError raised by the market view, which is constructed with a hard visibility bound and cannot be widened by the caller

classes.mutation: a fill is submitted for the decision session itself rather than the next session
classes.detector: FillTimingError raised by the order book, which requires fill_session to be strictly after decision_session and to be the next eligible exchange session

classes.mutation: share count multiplied by the recorded split ratio on the split session
classes.detector: value-continuity invariant across every corporate-action session: marked position value may not jump by the split ratio; CorporateActionError

classes.mutation: credit the dividend on the session after the ex-date, and separately credit it twice
classes.detector: benchmark reconciliation between the provider adjustment factor and the explicit reinvestment model, plus a per-event cash-credit assertion in the fixture

classes.mutation: extend the run beyond a symbol's last session while holding it, without liquidating
classes.detector: the engine liquidates at the last available close and marks the symbol ineligible; DelistingError if a position survives its symbol's final session

classes.mutation: remove a bar from the middle of a series while the calendar still reports a session
classes.detector: fills rejected with STALE_PRICE; the equity point flagged stale; a stale run longer than the declared limit raises DataIntegrityHalt

classes.mutation: fill an order larger than available cash; skip the cash debit on a fill
classes.detector: the cash-conservation invariant checked after every event: closing cash equals opening cash minus debits plus credits, exactly, in Decimal; and cash may never be negative

classes.mutation: round share quantity up instead of down; round a buy notional down instead of up
classes.detector: the adverse-rounding invariant: for a buy, charged notional is greater than or equal to quantity times effective price; for a sell and for dividend cash, credited amount is less than or equal to it; MIN_NOTIONAL rejection is asserted separately

classes.mutation: set every fee to zero; apply the sell-side fees to a buy
classes.detector: hand-calculated fixture equality on each fee component, plus the invariant that every fill carries a strictly positive total cost

classes.mutation: fill a buy below the reference price and a sell above it
classes.detector: the adverse-price invariant asserted on every fill: effective buy price is strictly greater than the reference, effective sell price is strictly less

classes.mutation: apply the position and cash effect of an order that was rejected
classes.detector: rejections are recorded with a reason code and asserted to leave cash, position, and equity byte-identical to the pre-order state

classes.mutation: submit an identical order twice on the same session
classes.detector: DuplicateOrderError from the order book, which rejects a repeated deterministic order id and a second live order in the same symbol on the same session

evidence.control_note: the sealed standard is that a class is satisfied only if the clean engine passes AND the mutated engine is caught, so the controls are part of the evidence
evidence.coverage_established_by: the harness AST-parses tests/adversarial/test_stage2_defects.py and matches real test names; it does not compose node ids from a naming convention, which would report success for tests nobody wrote
evidence.standard: two-sided: a class counts as covered only if the clean engine passes and the mutated engine is caught

look_ahead_empirical_check.note: every bar after the run end was deleted and both digests were unchanged; a companion test asserts the truncation actually removed bars, because a truncation that deleted nothing would pass against an engine that peeks

hand_calculated_fixtures_match.required: independent hand-calculated fixtures match engine output

evidence.independence: the arithmetic was written into config/stage2_engine_spec.json, with its derivation, before any engine module existed; engine_modules_present_at_seal_time was recorded as 0
evidence.granularity: compared line by line rather than on final equity alone, which two compensating errors would satisfy

evidence.why_the_two_methods_must_agree: under the adjustment convention Stage 1 measured, adj_t = close_t * prod_{s>t}(1 - D_s/close_{s-1}), which forces reinvestment at close_{s-1} - D_s; the residual is accumulated decimal rounding over the dividend events, not a modelling disagreement

tradable_spy_buy_and_hold.note: A real USD 100 cash account, not an index. Two variants are reported because constitution §5.1 places the 15% research shutdown on a strategy and this run is a benchmark; the sealed check passes under both readings, so the ambiguity does not affect the gate.
